headline: 6 active Cooler V2 contracts + 3 deprecated Clearinghouse V1 contracts + factory and kernel discovered on Ethereum
short_headline: 9 Cooler Loans contracts catalogued on Ethereum

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search performed for Cooler Loans; multiple contract deployments located via official documentation links.
Official deployments documented in Olympus Docs at https://docs.olympusdao.finance/main/contracts/addresses listing all Cooler V2 policy contracts, modules, and periphery.
No audit PDFs linked in protocol.audit_links; protocol documentation and GitHub repository indicate ongoing development via OlympusDAO.
GitHub source code repository identified at https://github.com/ohmzeus/Cooler; deployment artifacts and contract definitions documented in README and source files.
Protocol.chains specifies Ethereum only; all discovered addresses are on Ethereum mainnet. No multi-chain deployments required.
CoolerFactory contract identified; no enumeration of child Cooler instances performed as factory creates dynamic loan escrow contracts per user-debt-collateral pair.

Role taxonomy applied: policies, modules, periphery, and deprecated contracts identified with appropriate role labels. Actor classes determined from contract type (governance, multisig, or policy contract).

rationale.verdict: Discovery phase catalogued 9 Cooler Loans contract addresses across Ethereum, including 6 active V2 contracts (MonoCooler, LTV Oracle, Treasury Borrower, DLGTE, Composites, Migrator), 3 deprecated V1 Clearinghouse versions, plus CoolerFactory and Kernel dependencies. All addresses sourced from official Olympus documentation and verified against GitHub repository; governance via Olympus DAO multisig on Ethereum.

evidence.shows: Cooler Loans V2 contract addresses table listing MonoCooler (0xdb591Ea2e5Db886dA872654D58f6cc584b68e7cC), LTV Oracle (0x9ee9f0c2e91E4f6B195B988a9e6e19efcf91e8dc), Treasury Borrower (0xD58d7406E9CE34c90cf849Fc3eed3764EB3779B0), DLGTE (0xD3204Ae00d6599Ba6e182c6D640A79d76CdAad74), Composites (0x6593768feBF9C95aC857Fb7Ef244D5738D1C57Fd), Migrator (0xe045bd0a0d85e980aa152064c06eae6b6ae358d2) on Ethereum mainnet.

Comprehensive address registry including Cooler V2 policy contracts, deprecated Clearinghouse V1 versions (v1.2: 0x1e094fE00E13Fd06D64EeA4FB3cD912893606fE0; v1.1: 0xE6343ad0675C9b8D3f32679ae6aDbA0766A2ab4c; v1.0: 0xD6A6E8d9e82534bD65821142fcCd91ec9cF31880), CoolerFactory (0x30Ce56e80aA96EbbA1E1a74bC5c0FEB5B0dB4216), deprecated CoolerFactory (0xDE3e735d37A8498AD2F141F603A6d0F976A6F772), Kernel (0x2286d7f9639e8158FaD1169e76d1FbC38247f54b), and DAO multisig (0x245cc372C84B3645Bf0Ffe6538620B04a217988B).

Source repository documenting architecture: Cooler.sol escrow contract, CoolerFactory.sol deployment factory, and Clearinghouse.sol lending facility policy contract. Latest release v1.0.1 dated Sep 28, 2023.

Olympus V3 Default Framework documentation identifying Cooler Loans policies (MonoCooler, LTV Oracle, Treasury Borrower) and related modules/periphery within the protocol architecture. Clearinghouse marked as deprecated.

unknowns: D6: CoolerFactory enumeration capped at discovery phase; full enumeration of deployed Cooler instances deferred to downstream evaluation slices

protocol_metadata.about: Cooler Loans is Olympus DAO's protocol-native, perpetual lending system that allows OHM token holders to borrow USDS by collateralizing gOHM tokens. V2 introduces a fixed-rate 0.5% APR borrowing model backed by Olympus Treasury, eliminating price-based liquidations and enabling perpetual borrowing. Core system comprises MonoCooler policy managing loan state, LTV Oracle defining collateral ratios, and Treasury Borrower connecting disbursements to the Olympus Treasury.
